test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Jaya invested Rs. 14800 at 8.5% per annum on simple interest. The interest earned after 6 months is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate for 6 months (half year) = 8.5% ÷ 2 = 4.25%

Simple Interest = 4.25% of 14800

Simple Interest = 4.25 × 148 = 629

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 629.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 14800

Rate (R) = 8.5% per annum

Time (T) = 6 months = 6 ÷ 12 = 1/2 year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Principal
 Rs. 14800

 
 Simple Interest
 Rs. 629

 
• 
 R = 8.5% p.a.
 T = 6 months

 I = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (14800 × 8.5 × 1/2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (148 × 8.5) ÷ 2

⇒ SI = 74 × 8.5

⇒ SI = 629

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 629.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Simple interest is calculated on the original principal for the entire given period. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Compound Interest (CI)

Compound interest is calculated on the principal as well as the accumulated interest of previous periods. Formula: Amount = P(1 + R/100)T.

Rule of 72

A quick trick to estimate the number of years required to double the invested money at a given annual fixed interest rate. Time ≈ 72 ÷ Rate.
